en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The objective of this course is to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of contemporary technologies used in server services development. This includes the utilization of modern PHP frameworks, the application of security technologies such as JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for server applications, and the creation of robust and scalable REST and SOAP services. By the end of the course, students will possess a sophisticated skill set that is crucial for developing, securing, and maintaining high-quality web services.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Final Evaluation and Project Review: The course concludes with an examination through the UIS eLearning environment, covering topics such as SQL, database systems, web applications, API creation, and web services. The test holds a potential 50 points, with a minimum requirement of 25. At least 12 points must be achieved through open-ended questions. In addition to the test, students are expected to submit a project demonstrating the acquired knowledge and skills related to the topics discussed throughout the course. This project also bears a potential score of 50 points, with a minimum requirement of 25 points to pass.
